definitions.gloss: to perform, to play (a role), to act
definitions.explanation: To portray a character on stage, in film, or in other performances. Also used figuratively for playing a role or part in real life.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{主役|しゅやく}を{演|えん}じた。
{悪役|あくやく}を{演|えん}じるのは{難|むずか}しいと{言|い}われている。
examples.english: It's said that playing the villain is difficult.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}はチームの{中|なか}で{重要|じゅうよう}な{役割|やくわり}を{演|えん}じている。
examples.english: He plays an important role within the team.

notes:
USAGE:
Takes を to mark the role being performed: {役|やく}を{演|えん}じる (to play a role). The figurative usage ({役割|やくわり}を{演|えん}じる — to play a role/part in something) is also very common.

Related to the noun {演技|えんぎ} (acting, performance). An older variant form is {演|えん}ずる.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {役|やく}を{演|えん}じる: to play a role
- {主役|しゅやく}を{演|えん}じる: to play the lead
- {役割|やくわり}を{演|えん}じる: to play a part (figurative)
- {悪役|あくやく}を{演|えん}じる: to play the villain
